scoring_justification: Cannot fully recompute ΔA from the raw shell-model input in the verifier; compare the reported ΔA to the paper gold with a tolerance reflecting numerical spread, and enforce internal consistency with the softening percentage.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold ΔA = -4.3 (in e^2/(2V)) for NaCl:H^- system, and perfect-lattice A = 9.77 from Table 2 of the paper. Used to validate agent's fitted ΔA and compute expected softening.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 2: 'NaCl H−' row gives ΔA = -4.3, A = 9.77 from reference [30] (Raunio & Rolandson 1970).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from published table; values are the paper's own fitted result.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are taken verbatim from the paper's Table 2; they are the exact published results we ask the agent to reproduce.

outputs.description: Fitted change in nearest-neighbour short-range force constant ΔA (in e²/(2V)) and the corresponding softening percentage relative to the perfect-lattice A parameter (9.77).
